records.title: Large language models can consistently generate high-quality content for election disinformation operations
records.reason: The paper evaluates whether LLMs generate convincing localized election disinformation and how humans detect it; its experiments are capability/safety benchmarking, not inference-cost optimization.

records.title: P3 ViT: A CIM-Based High-Utilization Architecture With Dynamic Pruning and Two-Way Ping-Pong Macro for Vision Transformer
records.reason: P3ViT is a CIM accelerator for vision transformers with dynamic token pruning, ping-pong scheduling, and reported energy/speed gains, but it targets ViT rather than language-model inference; publisher full text could not be accessed.

records.title: Spikingformer: A Key Foundation Model for Spiking Neural Networks
records.reason: Spikingformer reduces non-spike computation in SNN transformer backbones and evaluates vision, neuromorphic, and language tasks; evidence is for a specialized SNN foundation architecture, not a concrete LLM serving optimization.

records.title: Harmony in Divergence: Towards Fast, Accurate, and Memory-efficient Zeroth-order LLM Fine-tuning
records.reason: DiZO changes zeroth-order LLM fine-tuning updates and reports up to 48% fewer training GPU hours; gains concern training rather than deployed inference, despite the linked FPGA-inference lineage.

records.title: Advancements and Applications of Large Language Models in Natural Language Processing: A Comprehensive Review
records.reason: The DOI publisher page could not be retrieved as readable full text in this run; the available record describes a broad LLM review, without a paper-specific inference optimization established from primary text.
